commits.subject: Stamp San Francisco's date on its card
San Francisco: fix the white roofs, relight for hard sun and a real sunset, /free-fall opens the game
commits.lede: Every flat roof on every corniced building was drawn white: the cornice band is a solid slab the size of the building and its lid sat on or above the roof deck. The band now has no lid, only the overhanging ring.

commits.subject: New favicon and app icon: the pixel V tile from the Arcade look
commits.lede: Jack picked option 1 from the coin and favicon sheet. Sky-blue tile, white pixel V, navy drop shadow on the larger sizes; strokes are two pixels wide so the V still reads in a 16 px browser tab. Regenerated every size index.html and the manifest point at, added a favicon.ico (baseAccount already asked for one), cache-busted the favicon links and moved theme-color to the Arcade blue. scripts/make-app-icon.py replaces

commits.subject: Make Arcade the front page, with Sky and Postcard one click away
commits.lede: - / now renders the Arcade look. On desktop a small Look switcher in the corner flips to Sky or Postcard and remembers the choice; phones always get Arcade. ?look= previews one without saving it. - $VIBE shows market cap instead of price per coin in all three looks. - Arcade headings and cards use Fredoka (self-hosted) so the pixel font is kept for the wordmark and HUD labels only. - The 3D VibeVerse mark sits beside

commits.subject: Three cover-art directions for the front door, at /redesign
commits.lede: Jack's note: the homepage does not look like the VibeVerse cover (blue sky, floating islands, a white pixel wordmark, a serif "What kind of adventure do you want today?") and feels glitchy on first open. These are three working candidates for /, for him to choose between. The live homepage is untouched.

commits.subject: Show the $VIBE price to first-time visitors
commits.lede: The market chip had one source, the vibe-holdings edge function, and a first visit has no cached figure, so any miss on that one request left the chip reading "$VIBE —" for the whole visit. The function logs show far more browser preflights than POSTs, and the function returns price: null whenever its own GeckoTerminal read fails.

commits.subject: Stamp Thalassa's date on its card
Thalassa: a Greek harbour town you can walk, swim and visit in VR
commits.lede: A new world at /thalassa (also /harbor, /harbour, /greek-harbor), built to look like Jack's painting: a walled town with terracotta roofs wrapped round a turquoise bay, a market on the quay, docks and a lighthouse mole, cypress and olive hills, and a temple on a cliff island reached by an arched stone bridge and a winding stair, with galleys under striped sails out at sea.
